title: [P0-02] Decide the tenancy model: one village per deployment, or a shared multi-village database
body:
## Summary

The roadmap assumes **tenant = village** (one backend serving several villages). The code today serves one village. The choice changes how much work Phase 0 is, so decide before building anything.

**Options**
- **A. One deployment per village** (separate Vercel project and database). No code changes; each village has its own admin and data. Costs more to operate as villages grow.
- **B. Shared database with `village_id`** (the roadmap). One deployment, central super admin. Needs P0-03 to P0-08 and touches every table.
- **C. Stay single-village** until a second village is actually planned.

**Recommendation:** C now, designed so B is possible later. Pick B only if a second village is planned within about six months.

## Tasks

- [ ] Confirm whether a second village is planned, and when
- [ ] Pick A, B or C and record it in `docs/adr/0001-tenancy.md`
- [ ] If A or C: close P0-03 to P0-08 as not planned, and review P6-05, P11-07

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] ADR merged
- [ ] Dependent issues updated or closed

title: [P2-07] Decide where background work runs (the container sleeps after 5 minutes idle)
body:
## Summary

The README states the Vercel container sleeps after 5 minutes without traffic, jobs use `:async`, and the daily reminder runs from Vercel Cron. A long-lived worker (Sidekiq in the roadmap) cannot run there. Push fan-out (P2-08, P9) needs a plan.

**Options**
- **A. Outbox table + Cron.** Deliveries are rows; a cron-triggered endpoint processes a batch per tick. Works on the current hosting; latency of a minute or more.
- **B. Always-on worker** (Render, Fly or Railway) with Solid Queue on Postgres. Real-time delivery; a second service to run.
- **C. Move the whole app** to a host with workers.

**Recommendation:** A for the first push release, B when volume or latency requires it.

## Tasks

title: [P5-02] Decide: should a firm stay listed (basic info only) when its owner has no subscription?
body:
## Summary

**Today** a firm is public only while its owner has a current subscription (`Firm.visible`, README "Subscriptions").

**Your latest requirement** says owners cannot add photos or videos without a subscription and subscribers get display priority. That implies unsubscribed firms are still listed, with basic data only.

**Options**
- **A. Keep today's rule** (no subscription, not listed). Strong incentive to pay; real owners can't appear until approved and paid.
- **B. Free basic listing.** Every approved firm is listed; subscription unlocks media, priority and extras. More complete directory for villagers; weaker payment incentive.

**Recommendation:** B, because a directory with few firms is not useful to villagers. It also makes the 79 imported places consistent with real owners later.

## Tasks

- [ ] Choose A or B
- [ ] If B: change the `visible` scope and update README, specs and the Android app copy
